feature_selection_rationale.reason: High missingness across almost all participating clinical centers (>96% missing); unreliable across sites.
Billing artifact without direct pathophysiological relationship to acute readmission risk; high missingness.
High missingness and high cardinality (73 categories) causing severe risk of overfitting on sparse specialties.
Excluded to maintain strict clinical parsimony around the principal admitting diagnosis (diag_1) and avoid multicollinearity.
Intake channel categories provide redundant signals already captured by prior utilization counts and primary diagnosis.
Excluded to maintain parsimony; inpatient intervention intensity is already represented by time_in_hospital and num_lab_procedures.
Redundant comorbidity signal that tracks closely with primary diagnosis category and length of stay.
Extreme unmeasured rate (>83-94% not ordered); testing frequency varies by admitting specialty rather than acute 30-day recidivism.
Highly redundant with insulin regimen and the medication-change (change) indicator.

feature_selection_rationale.feature: 22 individual antidiabetic oral medications (metformin, glipizide, glyburide, pioglitazone, etc.)
feature_selection_rationale.reason: Extreme sparsity across individual chemical agents (many <0.1% usage), zero variance for examide/citoglipton, and therapeutic volatility is already captured by insulin and change.
Administrative surrogate key; dropped to prevent memorization and data leakage.
Used exclusively for leak-free patient-grouped train/val/test splitting; removed from model input space.
Patients discharged to hospice or who expired in hospital cannot experience 30-day readmissions; excluded to prevent target contamination.

audit_metadata.deployed_policy: Single unified 12.0% threshold deployed across all encounters; group-based thresholds are not deployed.
audit_metadata.data_provenance: Published as de-identified by its source (UCI Machine Learning Repository, 130 US hospitals, 1999-2008). We did not independently verify de-identification.
known_limitations: Modest discrimination (AUC ~0.65) reflecting historical EHR administrative data limitations.
Data from 1999-2008 and diabetic inpatient encounters only; lacks external or prospective validation.
Subgroups with <100 readmissions (Asian n=124, Hispanic n=405, Other n=308, <30 Years n=512) are too small to conclude statistical parity.
Fairness evaluated on three recorded demographic attributes only (race, sex, age); clinical comorbidities may correlate with demographic distributions.

unmitigated_deployed.cutoff_description: Unified 12.0% threshold across all encounters (deployed in worklist & calculator)

mitigated_analysis_only.model: Validation-Tuned Group Cutoffs (Analysis only, not deployed)
mitigated_analysis_only.cutoff_description: Caucasian: 12.1%, African American / Other: 12.0% (fit on validation only)
mitigated_analysis_only.parity_tradeoff_note: Mitigation raises the Caucasian threshold to 12.1% on validation to narrow disparity, which lowers Caucasian recall on test from 58.7% to 57.9% and lowers overall cohort recall from 57.62% to 57.05%. Group-specific cutoffs are NOT deployed in the active clinical workflow.
